notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
We've worked hard to implement full controller support with our game, ensuring it is fully playable on the Steam Deck.

The game is fully playable using the Dpad and the "A" button. 

There is a small technical glitch where some pixels appear around some of the text; however, none of these glitches affect the readability of the text.

We hope you enjoy our game while on the go! Let us know if there are any problems.
